issue: So you want to get a dog
the question it answers: What a dog really costs, and who does the six a.m. walk in February.
Whether they are ready to be reachable by anybody, at any hour, with no adult in the room.

issue: So you want to be online
the question it answers: Who can see them, who can message them, and what happens to all of it afterwards.
Whether you know this home, and whether your child has a way out they will use.

issue: So you want to go on your own
the question it answers: Whether your kid has the judgement for this particular journey, and knows what to do when it goes wrong.
Which part they hate: the thing, the person, the practising, or the level. Four problems, four different fixes.

issue: So you want to stay home alone
the question it answers: Whether they know what to do about the doorbell, the alarm, the locked door, and not being able to reach you.

issue: So you want your own money
the question it answers: Whether you are going to let them lose it.
Whose time it is now, and what happens the first time work and school collide.

issue: So you want to change how you look
the question it answers: Whether it is reversible. If it is, why are you in the conversation at all?

issue: So you want to go out with someone
the question it answers: Whether you are someone they can report to without a scene.
